content: Rifabutin reduces the plasma levels or therapeutic effects of stiripentol by inducing the metabolism of the drug through hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. If coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers cannot be avoided, the dose of stiripentol should be increased to maintain efficacy. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of sunitinib by enhancing its metabolism via CYP3A4. Alternative drugs should be considered to avoid reduced efficacy. Rifabutin reduces the plasma levels or effects of tacrolimus by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug to maintain therapeutic levels. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of tazemetostat by increasing its metabolism through CYP3A4. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative treatments. Rifabutin reduces the plasma levels or effects of temsirolimus by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug to ensure therapeutic efficacy. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of tezacaftor by enhancing its metabolism via CYP3A4. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative treatments. Rifabutin reduces the plasma levels or effects of theophylline by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug to maintain therapeutic levels. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism, while tipranavir increases rifabutin levels by inhibiting its metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug to prevent adverse interactions. Rifabutin reduces the plasma levels or effects of tivozanib by enhancing its metabolism through CYP3A4. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative treatments. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of tolterodine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug to maintain therapeutic efficacy. Rifabutin reduces the plasma levels or effects of triazolam by enhancing its metabolism via CYP3A4. Avoid coadministration or consider alternative treatments. Rifabutin decreases the levels or effects of tucatinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism, while tucatinib increases rifabutin levels by inhibiting its metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug to prevent adverse interactions. If unavoidable, reduce the dose of CYP3A substrates according to product labeling. Rifabutin reduces the efficacy of the live typhoid vaccine through pharmacodynamic antagonism. This combination is contraindicated. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug to maintain therapeutic efficacy. Rifabutin decreases the plasma levels or effects of vonoprazan by enhancing its metabolism through CYP3A4. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of abiraterone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. If unavoidable, increase the abiraterone dosage frequency from once daily to twice daily. Rifabutin decreases the plasma levels or effects of alfentanil by enhancing its metabolism via CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of alfuzosin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the plasma levels or effects of atazanavir by enhancing its metabolism via CYP3A4, while atazanavir increases rifabutin levels by inhibiting its metabolism. Reduce the rifabutin dose by up to 75% (e.g., 150 mg every other day or three times per week) and monitor for rifabutin-associated adverse reactions. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of atogepant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Adjust the atogepant dosage to 30 mg or 60 mg daily when coadministered with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers. Rifabutin decreases the plasma levels or effects of atovaquone by enhancing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of avanafil by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely, especially in patients with erectile dysfunction, as effectiveness may be reduced. Azithromycin increases the toxicity of rifabutin by inhibiting its metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the plasma levels or effects of belumosudil by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Increase the belumosudil dosage to 200 mg twice daily when coadministered with strong CYP3A inducers. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of bemiparin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the plasma levels or effects of benzhydrocodone/acetaminophen by enhancing its metabolism via CYP3A4. Use caution when discontinuing CYP3A4 inducers coadministered with benzhydrocodone, as plasma concentrations of hydrocodone may increase, potentially leading to fatal respiratory depression. Rifabutin decreases the plasma levels or effects of brexpiprazole by enhancing its metabolism via CYP3A4. Double the brexpiprazole dose over 1–2 weeks if coadministered with a strong CYP3A4 inducer. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of bromocriptine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of buprenorphine buccal by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the plasma levels or effects of buprenorphine subdermal implant by enhancing its metabolism via CYP3A4. Monitor patients for withdrawal symptoms if CYP3A4 inducers are newly initiated. If the dose of the CYP3A4 inducer cannot be reduced or discontinued, implant removal may be necessary, and the patient should transition to a buprenorphine dosage form that allows dose adjustments. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of buprenorphine transdermal by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the plasma levels or effects of buprenorphine long-acting injection by enhancing its metabolism via CYP3A4. Monitor patients transitioning from transmucosal buprenorphine coadministered with CYP3A4 inducers to ensure adequate plasma levels. If the dose is inadequate and the CYP3A4 inducer cannot be reduced or discontinued, transition the patient back to a buprenorphine formulation that allows dose adjustments. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of cabazitaxel by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers to maintain therapeutic efficacy. Rifabutin decreases the plasma levels or effects of calcifediol by enhancing its metabolism via CYP3A4. Drugs that stimulate microsomal hydroxylation reduce the half-life of calcifediol. Monitor closely and adjust therapy as needed. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of carvedilol by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin decreases the plasma levels or effects of cenobamate by enhancing its metabolism via CYP3A4. Increase the dose of CYP3A4 substrates as needed when coadministered with cenobamate. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of rifabutin by inhibiting its metabolism via CYP3A4. Reduce the rifabutin dose to 150 mg every other day and monitor for adverse reactions such as neutropenia and uveitis. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of cobicistat by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Adjust the rifabutin dose to 150 mg every other day when coadministered with cobicistat and monitor for adverse reactions. Rifabutin decreases the plasma levels or effects of crizotinib by enhancing its metabolism via CYP3A4. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A inducers to maintain therapeutic efficacy. Crofeler increases the levels of rifabutin by inhibiting CYP3A4 in the gut. However, systemic inhibition is unlikely due to minimal absorption. Use caution and monitor closely. Rifabutin reduces the levels or effects of cyclosporine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely.
